data.name: knittly
data.subTitle: Personal Project with Vue and TypeScript
data.description: A minimalist mobile-first application designed to help knitters track and manage their knitting projects. Features stitch counting, row tracking, and project organization with a clean, mobile-optimized interface built with Vue and TypeScript.

data.name: AIGenie
data.subTitle: University Project with Vue, Python, and TypeScript
data.description: A mobile web application that serves as a host for the AI Lab of OsloMet University. Features an interactive AI assistant chat interface, information about researchers, research project details, and upcoming events exploration. Developed in a team of four with cross-functional collaboration. I was responsible for the frontend development using Vue and TypeScript

data.name: ultimateTicTacToe
data.subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
data.description: A second-semester project in the 'Web Applications' module. This implementation of tic-tac-toe introduces an additional layer of complexity, where each square contains a smaller tic-tac-toe board. The mark on a small board determines the the next larger board, adding a strategic element to the game. The win of a small board determines the mark on the larger board.

data.name: WA-FeWo
data.subTitle: University Project with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS
data.description: A second-semester project in the 'Web Applications' module, focusing on the development of a booking platform for holiday flats. The application processes data from an Airbnb CSV file to display available rentals.
